attacks.name: Blistering Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Scorched Earth
steps: During the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, this character may remove the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition from the defender. If it does, add 3 dice to the attack roll.
After each attack is resolved, Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Necessary Measures (Affiliation: Thunderbolts)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, when an allied character deals |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack, after the attack is resolved, choose another allied character. The chosen character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Burning Drop
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. Then all other characters within |!range| 2 gain the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition and this character suffers 1 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Everything Including the Kitchen Sink
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Energy Absorption
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!energy| attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll, it may change 1 of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a Blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed in this way.

superPowers.name: Gamma Powered
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
